professional.title: Professional
professional.body: AI-native software engineer with deep platform knowledge and 10+ years of experience shipping production-grade Android, iOS, and backend systems across crypto, fintech, streaming, telecom, e-commerce, and transport. I pair agent-first execution with composable architectures, mentoring, and clean, testable code that scales.

personal.title: Personal
personal.body: Husband, dad, and lifelong explorer. When I’m not building mobile experiences, you’ll find me observing Saturn through my Dobsonian, photographing a family adventure, or reading something that challenges how I think. I also run a small Airbnb and laundry business—hands-on ventures supporting my journey toward financial independence. Fitness keeps me grounded; curiosity keeps me moving forward.
